Mango: The acid found in mangos is mainly citric acid. It also contains malic acid, tartaric, ascorbic and oxalic acid.

Tomato: Tomatoes are acidic, but they primarily contain citric acid and ascorbic acid (vitamin C), not tartaric acid. Tartaric acid is less commonly found in tomatoes.

Orange: Oranges are acidic fruits, and they primarily contain citric acid, not tartaric acid. Citric acid gives oranges their characteristic sour taste.
